content.review_text: This place is hands down the best Tonkatsu in London.

Made my way from Kingscross to try out Japanese style donkatsu.The experience was great as expected, food was delicious especially the batter was crispy and nutty. The best cheese katsu in London without a doubt. I highly recommend, I would be willing to revisit anytime soon
Great quality food, generous portions, and friendly service. Highly recommend!

This is one of my favourite restaurants in London and the lovely people here serve the best katsu in London without a doubt. The place itself has a comfortable setting and it's always a nice experience to dine here. Highly recommend the premium tonkatsu, but be warned that they run out of this very quickly!

We have been here twice for dinner now. We really wanted it to be amazing because it could be such a great addition to St. John’s Hill.We like the food (although on both occasions the premium pork tonkatsu was sold out, which was annoying). Service was a problem on both occasions. Most (but not all) staff were surly, curt and seemed irritated by our presence. Menus being snatched out of our hands and being told grumpily we must wait for 10 minutes outside because we arrived seven minutes before our booking were low points.I’m not sure we will come back, which is a real shame because the food is great (and at a fair price point too).
My fiancée and I loved this place, the staff were lovely and the food was amazing!We will absolutely be coming back

Best tonkatsu in London - crispy panko exterior and succulent pork on the inside. The staff were all so friendly and welcoming, and I especially liked the open kitchen interior. The cheese katsu is also a must-try, and the delightful side dishes (particularly the oyster!) were spectacular. A wide variety of desserts which were very high in quality (very impressed with the red bean paste) with draft beer that pair well with the food. Very good transport links too as the restaurant was situated only a 10-minute walk from Clapham Junction station. Will definitely come again soon 😊
Delicious katsu curry with fresh, quality ingredients.

Katsuro in St John’s Hill serves some of the most authentic Japanese fried pork I’ve had in London. The clean, minimalist décor instantly makes you feel like you’re back in Japan.We tried both the original and premium tonkatsu — excellent quality meat with a perfectly crispy coating. Absolutely delicious. We’ll definitely be back.
Food was reasonable for the price
Excellent food and service! Worth the trek
Best food ever. The katsu is the best I have ever eaten. And it is a beautiful atmosphere.
It was ok just kind of overrated ._.

First time trying this place, the food was nice and hot I ordered the Ebi katsu those prawns are sure big prawns. The breadcrumbs was not greasy at all. It was delicious. All the added extras complimented the dish well.My family ordered the pork and cheese Katsu and tonkatsu they enjoyed it very much.We would return to try their lunch as well, because the lunch menu is different.

The waiting time for our order was minimal. Although the curry sauce could have been a bit thicker, overall we were very satisfied with the meal. Even my husband, who is extremely picky about food, really enjoyed it, which made the experience even more pleasant. We would definitely visit again and are looking forward to trying other dishes on the menu.
종종 찾아가곤 합니다. 주문하고 음식이 나오기 까지 계속해서 의심하곤 합니다. 오버그라운드로 30분이 조금 넘게 걸림에도 올 만한 가치가 있었는가, 제가 돈까스를 그리 좋아하지 않는다는 점이요. 흠… 그정돈가? 싶은데 그 정도입니다. 맛있어요. 포장 주문해도 맛있지만, 뜨끈하게 먹는 돈까스가 참 맛있고 좋더라고요.
Perfect!!!!! it was all great - the heating was broken, but we were given complimentary tea! All the staff are Japanese, the food was excellent 👌
lovely food and great service!

A little hidden gem in Clapham Junction! This cosy spot serves authentic Japanese Don Katsu and other classic sides — and it’s dog friendly too. The main focus here is definitely on Katsu, and they do it brilliantly.The place is bright, with tasteful Japanese décor and well-spaced seating that makes dining comfortable. The staff are wonderfully polite and attentive — a genuine reflection of Japanese hospitality that many places in London have lost.The menu is straightforward, prices are fair, and portions are generous for the quality you get. I visited around 1pm, and the Premium Katsu had already sold out, so I went for the Pork Katsu Curry instead — it was absolutely delicious.Highly urge locals to take advantage of this place — it would be a real loss if we let this gem slip away!
Great veggie option (tofu katsu) and polite staff + quiet low level chat ambience. Only watch out is to order the curry sauce as an additional side to the katsu, but very quick when it was needed!
Really delicious food, and incredibly generous portions! We’ve been back a few times now and the cheese katsu is an absolute favourite! A lovely local spot!!
Great food, I absolutely loved it. Would come again.
Really great food and very generous portion!

I’m a local and very happy that I got to know this place recently. I’m Korean but I always missed Japanese style katsu with a variety of selections but it was hard to find them in London apart from central.Loved the cheese one as it reminded me of my childhood, pork katsu was classic and delicious, and tamago(egg) katsu was my first time trying and was amazing!Unfortunately premium pork katsu was sold out, I’ll definitely try this next time.Highly recommended and would come again soon with my partner 🙌

This is a place that truly excels at tonkatsu. It was the best cheese tonkatsu I’ve had in the UK, and it was absolutely worth coming all the way to this neighborhood for it. The soba, however, was a bit disappointing. 돈까스를 추가할수 있어서 일반 돈까스에 치즈 2피스 추가하는 조합을 제일 강추드립니다!
Everything was Absolutely amazing! Definitely coming back
Excellent food and really good service. A very filling meal so great value for money.
要走很久但很好吃
Authentic katsu!!!It has been years i see a katsu sando after I ate once in japan
Decent food, very average service. Particularly the male waiter. Everything seems like trouble for him, a shame that decent food is let down by poor service

세상에서 제일 맛있는 카츠를 파는 곳이에요!! 직원들도 친절하고 무엇보다 음식이 너무 맛있습니다. 프리미엄 돈카츠를 먹었는데 고기가 너무 부드럽고 밥도 맛있었어요👍 다음에 또 와서 다른 카츠도 먹어보고 싶어요! 영국에서 돈카츠 먹고 싶으면 여기로 오시는 거 강력 추천합니다ㅎㅎThey sell the best katsu in the world. Good service and mostly exceptional food. Would come again and try other dishes as well! Highly recommend.
Very nice katsu pork specialist restaurant.
Best katsu I have had outside of Japan. Lunch is unbelievable value.
Great, tasty food with a friendly atmosphere. Highly recommend it as a local, independent restaurant.Will definitely come back!
프리미엄카츠 진짜 부드럽고 고소해요!!!타마고카츠산도는 궁금해서 먹어봤는데 너무너무너무 맛있어요. 계란이 폭신폭신하고 딸기잼이 들어있어서 좋았어요! 친구는 원래 양이 적어서 늘 남기는데 이번에 싹싹 다 먹었어요.그리고 가게 안이 할로윈 분위기로 꾸며져 있어서 센스 있고 귀여웠어요~앞으로도 자주 올듯해요!

Heard good things about the place. Finally went to have lunch recently. A ted disappointed. Ordered the tonkatsu set, the katsu was little dry and luk warm. I expect the katsu to be hotter. The loin katsu is fine, might need some more seasoning though. Otherwise the rest of the set is okay. Have pickles, miso soup, the rice, tonkatsu sauce and cabbage with goma tare.In London standard, they are good not the best I have ever eaten. The frying needs to have more control, should consider offering katsu don on weekends too. Also can try to offer hire katsu (pork tenderloin), I personally like hire katsu, more softer and juicer.Price point wise it was alright.

We went there for lunchWe ordered premium set. The pork was too dry, bread crumbs was too thick. I doubted that they are using Japanese rice.Compared with Soboten 勝博殿in Japan , they just rate 5/10And the floor of the restaurant is soooo slippery!!!We definitely won’t go there again

I popped over to Katsuro for dinner last night, and honestly, everything was absolutely spot on. My wife and I had the tonkatsu and the premium cheese katsu, and it was good enough to compare with what we had back in Japan. The prices were great too, and the staff were so friendly that we’re definitely planning to go again.

I recently had the pleasure of dining at KATSURO in London, and it was an absolutely fantastic experience from start to finish. If you are looking for the best Katsu experience in the city, look no further—this is the place!The staff were incredibly welcoming and attentive, making the entire dining experience even more enjoyable. From the moment we walked in, the service was outstanding!

I've been dreaming of a proper tonkatsu place in London for about 20 years. This is it! I recommend they do okawari on rice and cabbage. Maybe they do, but it didn't seem obvious. Can't wait to come back
저녁시간때 방문했는데 따뜻하고 행복한 한끼를했습니다.등심돈카츠를 먹었는데 제가 일본을 갔을때와 같은 감동을 느꼈습니다!Katsuro는 영국에서 일본과 흡사한 경험을 할수있는 곳이자 저에게는 소중한곳입니다. 앞으로도 자주 방문하겠습니다:)
음식이 빨리 나오고 튀김이 식어도 되게 바삭해요직원분들도 되게 친절하고 서비스가 좋아요미소국이 진짜 검나 맛있고요 연어회가 비린맛이 없어요
직원분들이 친절하시고 음식이 다 넘 맛있어서 배부르게 먹었습니다! 인테리어도 편안한 분위기여서 지인분과 즐거운 시간 보냈어요! 런던에 계신분들이리면 꼭 들리시는 걸 추천해요!! 다음에 또 올 생각이에요!
As good as you’ll get in Japan!
One of the best Katsu’s I’ve had in London and the service was outstanding (+ you can bring your dog)
The food is superb and the presentation is excellent. We enjoyed our meals. The only issue is the floor is slippery.
Fantastic food and excellent, friendly service. Will definitely be coming back!
Lovely place food was excellent and cooked with love. Dog friendly as well here is katsu Bert’s
Really good food and value for money! I enjoyed their katsu set. The meat was really soft and not tough compared to other restaurants. Would definitely recommend!
The curry katsu don was pretty good, but the add-on items weren’t not that worth it given that the portion was extremely small
One of the best katsu restaurants in London.
Perfect Tonkatsu in London!
食物豐富美味，已推薦朋友，會再光臨
Amazing Katsu, great set meals!

Best Japanese Tonkatsu (Pork Cutlet) in the UK.The pork cutlets are crispy and juicy. Delicious, very close to Japan Standard. I recommend the Premium Tonkatsu set. It comes with truffle oil which is my favourite. Don’t forget to make a reservation because the restaurant is very full.
Amazing Katsu

I rarely leave reviews but I had to for this restaurant. First of all, the plain udon was perfect. The warm broth healed my soul. The menchi katsu and the tamago katsu were also beyond my expectation! I really liked the slight sweetness of the tamago katsu. Staff were very friendly and polite. Would like to visit again
10/10 authentic Japanese foodHighly recommend Ebi Katsu Set, Original Pork Katsu Set. I love everything we ate

This restaurant came up a few times on IG and was said to be the best Katsu in London. Went there last night, booked online which I would suggest as they do get quite busy. The price is very very decent, I would think it’s on the cheap side, 20 or less per head.My daughter had a zaru udon with menchi katsu which is minced pork a salami hosomaki. I wanted to try the premium set but it’s all sold out, so I went with the tonkatsu set and the side I ordered and tofu katsu.The udon and maki was good, the menchi katsu was juicy. My tofu katsu is was great. However my pork loin was dry which was exactly what I was worried about before I arrived. The pork in this country is quite lean in general. The panko crust was light, crispy and airy. It’s defo crunchy on the outside just not juicy on the inside like the menchi. I actually think the pork loin might be a bit overcooked as the colour on the crust was darker than the other katsu arrived. The taste was still good regardless. I highly recommend their tofu katsu.The disappointing bit was they didn’t serve the meal with a suribachi and surikogi which is a ridged ceramic mortar and the wooden pestle for customer to grind our own sesame seeds before mixing with the tonkatsu sauce. This is quite a standard for all tonkatsu restaurants in Japan and Asia. Here they serve the sauce with a bit of the sprinkle grind sesame. Second thing is the cabbage came topped with mayo. This is a personal thing coz I always prefer to have them with the tonkatsu sauce. All the other tonkatsu place I have been in Japan and Asia they always serve the mayo on the side. But I would ask them to skip it next time when I order. I think with these little touch it would bring the whole dining experience to the next level.Overall it’s pretty good and good value, the pickles and miso soup this came with the set was also good. Food was served quickly. We arrived at 6:35 and were done at 7:15. Food is good valued. You do get what you pay for. Staff are friendly. Will defo go back one more time for the premium set and try their curry sauce.
Juicy and tasty, overall nice! If the portions can be a bit bigger will be great
Was so yummy ! Thanks.

Best Katsu restaurant in London!!I went alone at 7pm.I was not sure I can get a table.but they were very friendly and gave me a table.Katsu was great, even side dish as well!I will definitely visit again!!
Real Japan KATSU(Japan cutlet) if you want, not the UK version.
프리미엄 돈카츠, 치즈카츠, 타마고카츠 주문했는데 지인짜 다 너무 맛있게 먹었어요! 와사비랑 핑크솔트가 같이 나오는 것도 너무 좋았고, 프리미엄 돈카츠에 나오는 트러플 오일도 진짜 최고엿서요…✨먹다가 배불렀는데도 남기기 너무 아쉬운 맛이라 끝까지 다 비우고 왔습니다🥹 다음에도 꼭 또 방문할게요 !

It was my first time trying katsu and it was very good! I did prefer the classic chicken katsu over the mozzarella katsu because it felt too much with the cheese and you could taste less the chicken. The katsu sauce was delicious and I liked that the dish came with a miso soup and pickled veggies; however, I would add way more pickled veggies there weren’t enough! The service was very fast and almost rushed because at 10pm we were almost thrown out the door. Overall, very tasty and filling but maybe a tad bit overpriced. I would not pay more than 18 for a katsu.

One of the best meals I've had in London. The chicken was so crispy on the outside and moist in the middle and the rice was excellent. The accompanying bowl of miso pairs so well with it.At £12/13 it felt reasonable too. I'll be back soon.Good service. No frills about the restaurant but clean and authentic inside.

The pork cutlet here is amazing! The meat is juicy and tender, and the coating is perfectly crispy. The sauce has a rich, savory flavor that goes really well with the rice and cabbage. The staff were friendly, and the place felt cozy. Definitely one of the best tonkatsu places I’ve tried in London!
delicious! service was quick (immediately got a table) and kind. katsu exceptionally crispy. lunch deal is great

In my opinion, the best place to eat in Wandsworth. The staff are so welcoming, the service is impeccable. I’ve never tasted such delicious Katsu , The cabbage with the sesame dressing was absolutely delicious. Everything was outstandingly good. We are so lucky to have this five minute walk from where we live. It will definitely be a regular place to visit. Also very reasonably priced.
10/10 cheese katsu is so amazing! My husband had Udon and he said it was very good. I wasn’t a fan of the curry sauce as I felt it needs a little bit more kick. still it was yum!!!!
장 예민해서 튀긴음식 먹으면 배아프고 안좋아하는데 여기는 속편하고 뭣보다 맛있음

Tonkatsu was done well, we had some bowls of rice with the sets that were on the cusp of cooked.Non-alcolohic drinks were a bit meh.The staff provided us with good service throughout. The floor was very slippery too.A second visit is unlikely

I visited Katsuro and ordered the chicken katsu,absolutely incredible. The coating was crisp and light, not greasy, and the chicken inside was tender and juicy. The crisp was sensational; every bite had that satisfying crunch that makes a proper katsu dish memorable.The tonkatsu sauce complemented it perfectly; rich, balanced, and not overly salty. Presentation was clean and appealing, and the portion size was generous without being excessive.Service was efficient and polite, and the restaurant itself had a calm, tidy atmosphere. You can tell they care about consistency and quality.Overall, a brilliant experience from start to finish. Easily a 10/10 meal, and I’ll definitely be coming back for that katsu again.
The closest we've felt to being back in Japan! Amazing food, wonderful service and very affordable. My lemon sour was heavenly.
Food is really good! Probably rhe best cheese katsu in europe
Came for a lunch on the weekend and it was exceptionally nice!The food was authentic and delicious. Staff were friendly and the atmosphere was good as well.100% recommend
An absolute must visit, exceptional katsu and great service. Highly recommend!
Never had such good authentic katsu in London before! The sake and the umeshu were also very tasty. Highly recommend!!

Really tasty katsu, crispy outside and tender inside, very authentic. The set menu is great, snacks great - especially fried shrimps are amazing. Loved the atmoshpere and service as well - kind staff and dishes served fast.
Best katsu in London!
100% the best katsu spot in London. Food is amazing.
Am I in Japan now?
Food is great but the meat in Tonkatsu is not that tender. I had a hard time biting the meat itself. The miso soup kinda lacks in flavour.

Cheese katsu was delicious! Portion was generous, and the sauce went perfectly with it. The only tiny thing I didn’t love was the miso soup. It’s not perfect, but it’s definitely worth ordering again.
Everything was fantastic! Staff were really lovely. Just wish they would not play the music so loud.
